notes.title: Color Escape 5.0 is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Color Escape v5.0 is out![/h1]

Linked to the upcoming release of the "Love Levels", the first DLC for the game that will add a lot of new gameplay mechanisms, a new version of the game is available to download. Mainly technical, it makes adding new levels easier for me, but also for you if you want to make some using the Godot Engine (feel free to ask more infos). There is also a huge improvement on the drag'n'drop that is now both smoother and more precise (blocks do not try to reach the center of your mouse anymore).

If you missed some levels, that's a good time to go back to the game and its secrets.

[h3]Release Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][TECH][/b] Possibility to add pre-formatted .pck files to add levels
[*] [b][GAME][/b] Improved Drag'n'Drop
[/list]
[b]
See you on February 14th for the DLC release,
[/b]
[i]Le DoubleSept[/i]

notes.title: Color Escape: New Name, New Look, New Levels!
notes.content:
Hello,
Today a big big new version of the game was just released, changing a lot of appearance of the game and changing its name.

[h1]Why a new name?[/h1]


I was in an intense brain-storming with myself on how to have more people try the adventure and give feedbacks when I found that the "echochromy-austere" look of the game could be sending wrong signals to the audience and I chose to rebrand everything (levels, menus, logo) to a more "casual coop fun" way. But the name was not matching with the new game look. You cannot have a funny balloony "Escape From The Void" without creating a neural paradox.

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

There is new quality-of-life improvements, such as a new way of moving blocks around on the computer, clearer menus and some levels have been reworked to keep the pace of the adventure.

Also, I added more than [b]10 new secret levels[/b]. I chose to add secret levels and not just new ones at the end of the adventure to keep this increased pace and make them facultative. I wanted to have some kind of replay value and reward system.

So say hello to "Color Escape: VR Coop"

Have fun :)
Double Sept

notes.title: The 3.1 version is out!
notes.content:
Hi :)
I just released a new version of the game (v3.1) that fixes a lot of small (and bigger) bugs.

[list]
[*]     The most important change is on the way the block moves, as they now try to reach your mouse position at all time.
[*]     Some levels that were really to long has been simplified (mainly on advanced levels)
[*]     Some levels that were not playable due to a bug are no playable again
[/list]

I tried to test this version way more intensively that the previous one but if you still find a bug let me know.

This 3.1 version should be the last one before a big, big update (allegedly bigger than the 2.0->3.0 update)
